    LargeIndecomposable.cycleCoords

    Cycle coordinates on the cycle quiver #

    The cycle quiver cycleQuiver n ε with r = n + 2 vertices gets the cycle coordinates of FinQuiver.CycleCoords: the sink u is at position 0, the vertex some j at position j + 1; the first arrow into u is at position 0, the middle arrow j at position j + 1, and the second arrow into u at position n + 1.
